endpoint.name: Copilot answer — text, sources, shopping, places
endpoint.summary: Runs a prompt through the live Microsoft Copilot interface from a chosen country and returns the answer text with its cited sources, citation pills, shopping cards and map entries.
endpoint.call_template: treg call cloro.ai-search.copilot.scrape --method POST --data '{"prompt":"what is a stock split","country":"US","include":{"markdown":true,"html":true,"rawResponse":true}}'

cost.note: 5 base + the 2-credit sync surcharge. Every include flag on this endpoint is free — only `state` moves the price, by 2. A failed extraction is not charged.

prompt.example: best crm for a small agency

country.note: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. BY, CN, RU, SY and VE are refused.

state.note: US state code for state-level targeting; adds 2 credits

include.note: any of markdown, html, rawResponse. All three are free on this endpoint.

endpoint.capability_description: Scrape a live Microsoft Copilot answer page for a keyword

samples.reason: GB Copilot recommendation prompt returned 4 cited sources plus the grounding query; showed reliance on listicles and directories.
Branded query returned a detailed answer with five cited pages and the search query used; clear view of what Copilot knows about the brand.
Useful member examples and it cites the official member list, but the answer doesn't clearly distinguish the collective from individual certified travel businesses.
